primitives.name: Runtime Integrity Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: Fix the runtime foundation first: DB auth, /api/health, homepage, board, promotions API.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'I_{integ}': 'dimensionless integrity score', 't_{init}': 'time to initialize core routes'}
primitives.assumptions: All public routes must pass a fail-closed validation before serving user requests.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When I_{integ} < 0.8, all non-critical routes are suspended.

layer2.mapping: GSI's trust inference maps to GSE's state transition graph where each node represents a validated runtime component.
layer2.telemetry: API health check success rate and latency distribution

primitives.name: Trust Explainer System
primitives.verbatim_quote: Convert methodology from a static trust page into a safe explainer system: what users can trust, what stays private, and how to act.
primitives.assumptions: Users must be able to derive actionability within 10 seconds of exposure.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When T_{expl} > 0.9, user comprehension degrades due to over-explanation.

layer2.mapping: GSI's trust model is derived from GSE's contextual explanation engine using entropy-weighted signal processing.
layer2.telemetry: User dwell time on trust pages and click-through rate on action buttons

primitives.name: Risk Ladder
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Risk ladder: lower-risk, volatile, and no-bet education that makes restraint feel intelligent.
primitives.assumptions: Risk perception must align with user behavior to avoid cognitive dissonance.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When E_{edu} < 0.5, risk ladder fails to influence user decisions.

layer2.mapping: GSE's risk ladder is a derived kernel from GSI's behavioral trust model, mapping risk levels to educational interventions.
layer2.telemetry: User selection frequency across risk tiers and post-selection behavior change
